about: A project that comes with LNF Run Log. Import it from Settings → Backup and data, or add it there under Projects that come with the app.

projects.author: Nick Reynolds
projects.name: nrr_regjig_v9_1
projects.goal: Registration-jig sweep v9 on 100 mm DSP prime Si p/B ⟨100⟩, 525 µm: a 2 µm wet-oxide hard mask patterned on the µPG 501 (layer 1/0), run 1 on the Pegasus (Recipe 3, 150 cycles) for 375 µm blind windows, crosses and cleave lines, then 5 µm SPR 220 aligned to the run-1 crosses (layer 2/0) and run 2 (60 cycles) for the through-holes, grooves, wells, fullers, slots and tag bars.
projects.notes:
Open before booking: µPG single-layer selection at conversion; SPR 220 doses on the µPG (3 and 5 µm); autofocus over the 375 µm step; furnace recipe; DGRIE 4 in-on-6 in mounting; Bench 84 class ticket; back-face strip method.
Figures are from the LNF wiki pages (STS Pegasus 4 / LNF Recipe 3; SPR 220; STS APS DGRIE; Ar Descum; Solvent Bench 84; Material Restrictions; Heidelberg µPG 501 Mask Maker; TEL Mark Vz Coater) and are for verification, not instruction; [staff] marks what the wiki does not cover.

wafers.label: W2
wafers.notes: Joe’s wafer: joe_stage_nrr_regjig_sweep_v9.gds. Run 1 at 115 cycles, then measure and top up to 375 (5 % open, etches faster); run 2 at 150 / (X / N1) cycles.

steps.title: RCA pre-furnace clean
steps.notes: Not one of the README’s 24 rows: the LNF requires this clean as the step right before any CMOS-clean furnace tube, the same day (or kept in Tempress S2T1 storage in between). Bare wafer, nothing on it yet.

steps.title: Wet thermal oxide, 2.0 µm both faces [staff]
steps.notes: Bare wafer in. The furnace recipe is for staff to set. Hard-mask rates under Pegasus Recipe 3: thermal 222, HTO 219, LTO 230 Å/min; PECVD unknown.

steps.title: Measure the oxide thickness
steps.notes: 2.0 µm ± 10 %. It sets the DGRIE times. The Nanospec does as well.

steps.title: Coat SPR 220, 3 µm
steps.notes: HMDS vapour prime; soft bake 115 °C 90 s. 4 in wafer, no through holes, no backside PR. Wait at least 5 min before exposing.

steps.title: Expose layer 1/0, the oxide pattern
steps.notes: nrr_regjig_sweep_v9.gds, layer 1/0 only. Min feature 100 µm → High Throughput, about 108 min; field 103.4 × 104.0 mm (SOP 100 × 100; CLEAVE_OVERRUN_MM=0 → 100). Polarity clear, no mirror. SPR 220 dose: ask staff.

steps.title: Post-exposure bake and develop
steps.notes: PEB 115 °C 90 s; develop AZ726 – DP3030.

steps.title: Inspect the resist
steps.notes: Window 11.000 × 5.000 mm; cleave lines 100 µm; crosses 2.000 × 0.200 mm at (±30, ±30). Resist clear in the openings. Any inspection microscope.

steps.title: Etch the oxide, 2 µm
steps.notes: 0.26 µm/min, 2.5:1 to PR → 2 µm in about 7.7 min plus 10–20 % over-etch; about 0.8 µm of resist consumed. 4 in on a 6 in bare-Si carrier (mounting: ask staff); Semi-Clean.

steps.title: Check the oxide cleared in the openings
steps.notes: 0 µm in the window. Nanospec or microscope.

steps.title: Strip the resist
steps.recipe: Remover PG, acetone, IPA; DI; N2
steps.notes: Non-CMOS-clean from here → Semi-Clean Pegasus: a one-line ticket.

steps.title: Descum (optional)
steps.notes: PR descum and native oxide.

steps.title: RUN 1: Recipe 3, 150 cycles, oxide mask alone
steps.notes: 150 cycles at 12.5 s/cycle → 31 min. Window 375, crosses 375, cleaves 375 µm with a 150 µm web; blind; 19.1 % open; oxide −0.69 µm. W2 (Joe’s wafer, 5 % open, etches faster): 115 cycles, then measure and top up to 375.

steps.title: Measure the window floor depth X
steps.notes: 375 ± 15 µm; one cleave trench too (the Zygo NewView does as well). X short → step 13 tops up; X long → shorten step 20.

steps.title: Top up to 375 µm (if needed)
steps.notes: (375 − X) / (X / 150) cycles. No resist on the wafer, so this is free.

steps.title: Coat SPR 220, 5 µm, over the topography
steps.notes: HMDS; soft bake 115 °C 120 s plus a 30 s stepdown. Over 375 µm of topography, allowed (blind). The trenches fill and a fillet forms at the window walls: expected.

steps.title: Expose layer 2/0, the resist pattern, aligned to the run-1 crosses
steps.notes: Same file, layer 2/0 only, in Alignment mode on the run-1 crosses. Min feature 2 µm → High Precision, about 215 min. The 5 µm dose and autofocus over the 375 µm step: ask staff.

steps.title: Post-exposure bake and develop
steps.notes: PEB 115 °C 90 s; develop AZ726 – 50-50DP.

steps.title: Inspect the overlay
steps.notes: Doubled crosses give the overlay (ledge = w/2 ∓ d); floor clear except the wall fillet; cleave trenches still full; tags legible.

steps.title: Etch the oxide through the resist mask
steps.notes: About 7.7 min plus over-etch; about 0.8 µm of the 5 µm resist. Tightest: 2 µm tag bars through 2 µm oxide; the floors are already bare Si.

steps.title: Check Si exposed in a groove and a tag bar
RUN 2: Recipe 3, 60 cycles
steps.notes: 60 cycles → 12.5 min: window and crosses through; grooves 115/130/139/145/150; wells 150; fullers 100; slots 85; tag bars 66; cleaves stay at 375; 18.7 % open; resist −0.96 µm. If X ≠ 375: (525 − X) / (X / 150) cycles; over-etch a few % at most. W2 (Joe’s wafer): 150 / (X / N1) cycles.

steps.title: Inspect the through-holes and measure a groove
steps.notes: Through-holes with backlight; groove depth on the Dektak, one die per setting. A bottom ledge under the fillet is expected.

steps.title: Strip the resist
steps.recipe: Remover PG, acetone, IPA; DI; N2
steps.notes: As step 9. Through holes now: no more TEL.

steps.title: Back-face oxide strip [staff]
steps.notes: Front protected; under the 1 × 9 mm Ti/Pt/Au pads. The front oxide may stay. Method: ask staff.

steps.title: Cleave along the 100 µm lines
steps.notes: Snap the Si lands along the side grooves: 375 µm / 150 µm web against the proven 402 / 123. Snap the lands after bonding.
